paraphrase: Practice proceeds from mental repetition (mānas jap) and mental contemplation of form (mānas dhyān) to fixing the gaze at a point (dṛṣṭi yoga), which opens the inner light, and then to the meditation on sound (nādānusandhān), which leads to the soundless.
speaker: Maharshi Mehi
